कु + -शील a. rude, wicked, unmannerly, ill tempered, of bad character;
 कुतो गम्यमगम्यं वा कुशीलोन्मादिनः प्रभोः Ks. 32. 152.

कु + -ष्ठलम्
—1 a bad place.
—2 the earth; शयानां कुष्ठले Bk. 9. 84.

कु + -सरित् f. a small river, rill; उच्छिद्यन्ते क्रियाः सर्वा ग्रीष्मे
 कुसरितो यथा Pt. 2. 89.

कु + -सृतिः f.
—1 evil conduct, wickedness; कस्माद्वयं कुसृतयः खलयोनयस्ते Bhāg. 8. 23. 7.
—2 conjuring, magic.
—3 roguery.

कुसृतिः f. Fraud, cheating, deceit. कृतहस्तः स्वयं तत्र
 कुसृतिप्रकृतिः परः Śiva B. 24. 9. कस्माद्वयं कुसृतयः खलयोनयस्ते
 दाक्षिण्यदृष्टिपदवीं भवतः प्रणीताः^1 Bhāg.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260605. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/250.
कु + -स्त्री a bad woman.

कुश^1 a.
—1 Wicked, vile, depraved.
—2 Mad.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/5f7cee5.

—1 A rope.
—2 A bridle.

कुशः + .{@-शः@}
—1 A kind of grass considered holy and forming an essential requisite
 of several religious ceremonies; पवित्रार्थे इमे कुशाः Śrāddha Mantra;
 कुशपूतं प्रवयास्तु विष्टरम् R. 8. 18, 1. 49, 95.
—2 N. of the elder son of Rāma. [He was one of the twin sons of Rāma,
 born after Sītā had been ruthlessly abandoned in the forest; yet he
 was the elder of the two in point of first seeing the light of this world.
 He, with Lava was brought up by the sage Vālmīki, and the two boys were
 taught to repeat the Rāmāyaṇa, the epic of the poet. Kuśa was made
 by Rāma king of Kuśāvatī, and he lived there for some time after his
 fatherʼs death. But the presiding deity of the old capital Ayodhyā presented
 herself to him in his dream and besought him not to slight her. Kuśa
 then returned to Ayodhya; see R. 16. 3-42.]
—3 A rope of Kuśa grass for connecting the yoke of a plough with the pole.
—4 One of the great Dvīpas; Bhāg. 5. 1. 32.

कुशः + .{@-शी@} A sort of ladle.
—2 Wrought iron.
—3 Ploughshare.
—4 A pod of cotton.
—5 A piece of Udumbara wood used for counting the number of Sāmans in
 a Stotra; औदुम्बरे स्त्रियाम् । छन्दोगस्तोत्रगणनाशङ्कासु … … Nm.

कुशः + -अक्षः a monkey.

कुशयः, कुशपः A drinking vessel, cup, goblet.
कुशिन् a. Mixed or combined with water.

कुशेशयम् A water-lily, a lotus in general; भूयात्कुशेशयरजोमृदुरेणुरस्याः

कुशेशयम् + .{@-यः@} The (Indian) crane or Sārasa bird.

कुशल a.
—1 Right, proper, good, auspicious; कुशलं खलु तुभ्यमेव तद्वचनं
 कृष्ण यदभ्यधामहम् Śi. 16. 41; न द्वेष्टपकुशलं कर्म कुशले
 नानुषज्यते Bg. 18. 10.
—2 Happy, prosperous.
—3 Able, skilful, clever, proficient, well-versed; कृतान्तः कुशलः
 पुत्र येनास्मि व्यसनीकृतः Rām. 7. 54. 16 with loc. or in comp.; दण्डनीत्यां
 च कुशलम् Y. 1. 313, 2. 181; Ms. 7. 190; R. 3. 12.
कुषल a. Clever, expert.

कुशल + .{@-लम्@}
—1 Welfare, a happy or prosperous condition, happiness; पप्रच्छ कुशलं
 राज्ये राज्याश्रममुनिं मुनिः R. 1. 58; अव्यापन्नः कुशलमबले पृच्छति
 त्वाम् Me. 103; अपि कुशलं भवतः ‘are you doing well’ (how do you do?).
—2 Virtue.
—3 Cleverness, ability.

कुशल + .{@-लः@} An epithet of Śiva.
.━{@Comp.@}: कुशलकाम, कुशलप्रश्नः, कुशलबुद्धि
कुशल + -काम a. desirous of happiness.

कुशल + -प्रश्नः friendly inquiry after a personʼs health or welfare;
 cf. ब्राह्मणं कुशलं पृच्छेत् क्षत्रबन्धुमनामयम् । वैश्यं क्षेमं समागम्य
 शूद्रमारोग्यमेव च ॥ Ms. 2. 127; cf. also मयाप्तं रामत्वं कुशलवसुता
 न त्वधिगता । S. D.
कुशल + -बुद्धि a. wise, intelligent, shrewd, sharp.

—1 Cleverness, ability, conversancy with (loc.).
—2 Acuteness of sensation; यथा यथा निषेवन्ते विषयान्विषयात्मकाः ।
 तथा तथा कुशलता तेषां तेषूपजायते ॥ Ms. 12. 73.

कुशलिन् a. (-नी f.)
—1 Happy, doing well, prosperous; अथ भगवांल्लोकानुग्रहाय कुशली काश्यपः
 Ś. 5; R. 5; Me. 114. कुशलिनी वत्सस्य वार्तापि नो । S. D.
—2 Of lower caste; ‘कुशलिनं कारुकं चण्डालविशेषमित्यर्थः’ Nīlakaṇṭhaʼs
 commentary on Mb. 12. 291. 7. [पापानुबन्धं यत्कर्म यद्यपि स्यान्महाफलम् ।
 तन्न सेवेत मेधावी शुचिः कुशलिनं यथा ॥]

कुशिक a. Squint-eyed.
